segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Hi, this is Marissa from Northlake Dental Group. We need three more user seats added for our operations team, ideally today.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Yeah, I can help with that. I have Northlake Dental Group pulled up in the admin console. Can you confirm the workspace ID ends in 4182?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yep, 4182. We’re currently at 42 seats and need to go to 45.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Got it. I’m seeing 42 active seats on the Professional plan at $38 per seat per month. Adding three seats will prorate at $71.61 total for the rest of the billing period ending September 30.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That sounds right. Can you go ahead and add them?

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Done. The account now has 45 seats available. You can invite the three users from Admin, then Users, then Add user.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Perfect. Will the receipt go to billing at northlakedental dot com?

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Yes, the billing tool is set to send it there. You should see the receipt in a few minutes, and the prorated amount will also show on invoice 90817.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Great, that’s all I needed. Thanks for the quick help.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: You’re welcome. Ticket 62431 is noted and closed out.
